coordinates.locator: centroid of OpenStreetMap way 4372309 (Argonne campus fence, 131 nodes)
coordinates.note: Centroid of the OpenStreetMap outline of the fenced Argonne campus; a campus-grade point, so shown as approximate. It replaces a ROR geocoder point that sat about 4.4 km south-west, near Lemont, outside the campus.

summary.plain: The main Argonne National Laboratory campus near Lemont, Illinois, southwest of Chicago.
summary.technical: Argonne National Laboratory campus, southwest DuPage County, Illinois (Lemont address), 9700 Cass Avenue.
